package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// SandboxClient provides NATS-based access to sandbox service.
type SandboxClient struct {
	conn    *natsgo.Conn
	subject string
}

// NewSandboxClient creates a new sandbox NATS client.
func NewSandboxClient(conn *natsgo.Conn, subject string) *SandboxClient {
	return &SandboxClient{
		conn:    conn,
		subject: subject,
	}
}

// ArchiveAndUpload requests archive and upload via NATS.
func (c *SandboxClient) ArchiveAndUpload(ctx context.Context, sandboxID, answerID string) (string, error) {
	if c.conn == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("nats connection not available")
	}

	payload := map[string]string{
		"sandboxId": sandboxID,
		"answerId":  answerID,
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	msg, err := c.conn.RequestWithContext(ctx, c.subject, data)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	var resp struct {
		FileStorageID string `json:"fileStorageId"`
		Error         string `json:"error"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(msg.Data, &resp); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if resp.Error != "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf(resp.Error)
	}

	return resp.FileStorageID, nil
}
